metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: How Crataeis collects, uses, and protects your data.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: At Crataeis, I value your privacy as much as my own. This policy outlines exactly what happens to your data when you visit this site or reach out to me.

s1.title: 1. Information Collected
s1.body: I only collect information that you voluntarily provide to me via the contact form on this website. This typically includes:

bullets.b3: Message Content (any project details you choose to share)

s2.title: 2. How Your Data is Used
s2.body: I use this information solely to:

bullets.b3: Provide services if we enter into a contract.

s2.note: I do not use your information for unsolicited marketing or newsletters, and I will never sell your data to third parties.

s3.title: 3. Analytics (Privacy-First)
s3.body: This website uses Vercel Analytics to monitor site performance and traffic. Unlike traditional analytics tools:

bullets.b2: It does not track you across other websites.
bullets.b3: All data is de-identified and aggregated.

s3.note: I use this purely to see which parts of my site are helpful to visitors. You can choose whether analytics is enabled via the cookie settings banner; your choice is stored locally so you don't have to answer every time.

s4.title: 4. Third-Party Service Providers
s4.body: To run this site, I use a few trusted services:

bullets.b1: Hosting: Vercel (where the site is stored).
bullets.b2: Form Processing: Vercel Functions + Resend (to deliver your message to my inbox).

s5.title: 5. Data Retention & Your Rights
s5.body: I keep your contact information for as long as we are in active communication or as required by law for business record-keeping.

bullets.b1: Request a copy of the data I have about you.
bullets.b2: Request that I delete your personal information from my records.

s5.note: To exercise these rights, please contact me via the contact form on this website.

s6.title: 6. Security
s6.body: I use industry-standard SSL encryption (HTTPS) to ensure that the information you send through the contact form is encrypted during transit.

s7.title: 7. Contact
s7.body: If you have any questions about this policy, please reach out through the website contact modal.

summary.b1: Inquiries: Filling out our form is an inquiry, not a binding contract for services.

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.body: Welcome to our website. These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our site and the submission of inquiries through our contact forms. By using this website, you accept these terms in full.

s2.title: 2. Service Inquiries
s2.intro: Our website allows you to inquire about specific services. Please note:

bullets.b1: No Binding Agreement: Submission of an inquiry via the form does not create a formal contract or an obligation for us to provide services.
bullets.b2: Accuracy: You agree to provide a valid email address and accurate information so that we may respond to you effectively.

s3.title: 3. Prohibited Use
s3.intro: When using our contact form, you agree not to:

bullets.b1: Submit any content that is unlawful, defamatory, or infringes on third-party intellectual property.
bullets.b2: Use the "Message" field to upload or transmit viruses, Trojan horses, or malicious code.
bullets.b3: Use automated systems (bots) to submit inquiries.
bullets.b4: Use the form for unauthorized commercial solicitation (Spam).

s4.title: 4. Intellectual Property
s4.body: Unless otherwise stated, we own the intellectual property rights for all material on this website. You may view and print pages for your own personal use, but you may not republish or redistribute our content without written consent.

s5.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
s5.intro: While we strive to ensure our website is always available, we are not liable for:

bullets.b1: Any delays or failures in form delivery due to technical issues, internet outages, or server maintenance.
bullets.b2: Any loss or damage arising from your use of the website, to the maximum extent permitted by EU law.

s6.title: 6. Links to Other Policies
s6.body: Your use of the inquiry form is also governed by our <link>Privacy Policy</link>, which explains how we collect, use, and store your personal data (Name, Email, etc.) in accordance with GDPR.

s7.title: 7. Modifications
s7.body: We reserve the right to revise these terms at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last Updated" date. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

s8.title: 8. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
s8.body: These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of France. Any disputes relating to these terms will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in France.
